Hi Avery —

Thanks for applying to the SWE (inference) role — I reviewed your resume and would love to set up a brief 20‑minute phone screen so we can learn a bit more about your experience with model serving and latency optimizations.

Quick note: our hiring manager, Laura Bennett, is on the East Coast and has a narrow window late in her day. If you happen to be available late evening in your timezone (we can accommodate up to 10:30pm PDT / 1:30am EDT), would you be open to an exception? If not, no worries — we can find standard business hours.

- Tue Jun 11: 8:30–9:00pm PDT
- Wed Jun 12: 9:00–9:30am PDT (normal hours)
- Thu Jun 13: 4:30–5:00pm PDT

If any of those work, reply with your preferred slot and a phone number to reach you (or I can send a Google Meet link). I attached the resume you submitted for quick reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0148
